stem: What is a primary purpose of interprofessional education in health professions training?

options.A: Limit collaboration to administrative tasks so clinical decisions remain isolated within each profession.
options.B: Replace profession-specific education so all health professions develop an identical scope of practice.
options.C: Keep professions separated during training to avoid overlap in communication, roles, or team responsibilities.
options.D: Prepare learners to communicate, understand professional roles, and collaborate effectively in interprofessional team-based care.

rationale: IPEC's current Core Competencies for Interprofessional Collaborative Practice, Version 3, are intended to prepare learners for interprofessional collaboration and teamwork to improve person/client care and population health outcomes. The framework addresses values and ethics, roles and responsibilities, communication, and teams/teamwork. D reflects that purpose. A and C contradict collaborative practice, while B incorrectly erases profession-specific scope and education.
educational_objective: Recognize interprofessional education as preparation for effective communication, role understanding, and collaboration across health professions in team-based care.
source_document_title: Core Competencies for Interprofessional Collaborative Practice: Version 3
source_version_date: Version 3, November 2023; current IPEC framework rechecked 2026-08-16
source_locator: IPEC Core Competencies: Version 3 — purpose/vision and competency framework; domains addressing Values and Ethics, Roles and Responsibilities, Communication, and Teams and Teamwork
source_claim_supported: IPEC competencies are designed to prepare health-professions learners for interprofessional collaboration and teamwork in person/client-centered care and population health.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Printed p.7, Management of Care — Collaborate with interdisciplinary team members when providing client care; Manage care to meet client needs

source_original.stem: What is a primary purpose of interprofessional education in health professions training?

options.A: Limit collaboration to administrative tasks because clinical care should remain professionally isolated
options.B: Replace profession-specific education so every health profession develops the same scope of practice
options.C: Keep professions separated during training to prevent overlap in communication or team responsibilities
options.D: Prepare learners to communicate and collaborate effectively across professions in team-based care

source_original.rationale: IPEC's current Core Competencies are designed to prepare learners for interprofessional collaborative practice, including communication, roles and responsibilities, teamwork, and shared values in person-centered care.
source_original.source_detail: Version 3, November 2023; competency framework for interprofessional education and collaborative practice; accessed 2026-08-14.

correction_summary: Verified Version 3 as the current IPEC framework, aligned the key to its communication/roles/teamwork purpose, removed any implication that interprofessional education replaces profession-specific scope, and reduced difficulty from hard to easy because this is direct conceptual recognition.

audit_findings.currentness: IPEC identifies November 2023 Version 3 as its most recent Core Competencies update.
audit_findings.claim_audit: The IPEC framework explicitly prepares learners for interprofessional teamwork/collaboration and retains domains covering roles, communication, teamwork, and values/ethics.

distractor_audit.B: Interprofessional competence supplements rather than abolishes profession-specific roles/scope.

audit_findings.ambiguity_second_answer: Only D captures IPEC's educational purpose.
audit_findings.cueing: All options describe possible purposes of training; resolution depends on the interprofessional-care construct.
audit_findings.blueprint: NCSBN Management of Care, printed p.7, interdisciplinary collaboration.
audit_findings.independent_second_pass: Rechecked IPEC Version 3 current-status and purpose statements, challenged whether any alternative could describe a legitimate education goal, and confirmed D remained uniquely correct.
